answer: The gate that works is refundable entry stake vesting back only while grading stays clean: Every account posts a small refundable stake that vests back slowly and only while its grading record stays clean, so a sybil ring must lock real capital per identity and loses it when caught. One ember per identity, no bulk discount, no shared shortcut; the meadow the system trusts is earned history, and the bridge of the design is that the tenth fake costs ten times the first instead of the same price again.
